text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since I became
Nishino Flower's trainer.
Everything is
going smoothly, and our time together is
well spent.
One day...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if you want, I brought a bento box
for lunch.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Actually, my mom taught me this
recipe yesterday. And, I wanted
you to try
it too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Trainer's a really thorough teacher!
I'm having so much fun
during training!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm able to do a little bit more each day,
and that makes me want to
work even
harder.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds like you've forged a good
relationship with your trainer.
That's
wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! That's why I want to do something
for Trainer, but I don't
know where to
start. Do you have any advice?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Making a big deal out of things
might not work... Oh! How
about this? You
can present it as a casual gesture...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You liked the last bento I made, so... Um,
if you don't already have
something to eat,
that is—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A medley of colorful vegetables and
steamed foods jump out at me,
including
fried chicken and other items that are
delicious even when
they're not piping
hot. Each bite tastes of heartwarming
home
cooking.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: How... is it? Do you like it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The flavors are just right—I could eat
something like this every day. I
tell Nishino
Flower exactly that.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Every day?! U-understood! Ehehe... I'm
glad you liked it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She beams with happiness at having her
mother's recipe
complimented. I thank her
again and continue to eat with gusto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Today's bento is my dad's favorite. I hope
you enjoy it too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I have plans to hang out with some
friends, so I'll see you later.
Bye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a bow, she races away. I'm happy
about the bento box, but I
also wonder if
she isn't overexerting herself just to make
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she took what I said about being
able to eat her food every
day to heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If this is going to be a regular thing, then
the least I could do is pay
for the
ingredients. I'm eating the lunch box in the
trainer's office
when...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You hard at work as always? Are you
free for lunch? I figured we
could catch
up. If you're down for that, we're meeting
by the main
gate!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's one of the senior trainers who took me
under her wing. I'm starting
to feel stuffed
from my meal, but I also don't want to
refuse the offer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shovel the last of the food into my mouth
and dash toward the
academy gates.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I hope today's lunch box went over well. I
know they're Dad's
favorite foods, but I
hope Trainer likes them too.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(What should I make tomorrow? I'm sure
Mom will be happy to share
another one
of her recipes...)

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text: You all right? You hardly ate a thing!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...? Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I learned a lot about training and how to
improve partnerships with
our Umamusume
from my colleagues. I want to thank them
for inviting
me to lunch, but my stomach
can't take any more.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't force yourself to talk. Are you
coming down with
something? Sorry—we
wouldn't have invited you if we'd known.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be?
